title: Managed Database: commitment cancel allowed
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database commitment cancel allowed is specified by contracted tier. Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

| Contracted tier | Commitment cancel allowed |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | No |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | No |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | No |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | No |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | No |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | No |
